explanation: The vulnerable _build_client instantiated imaplib.IMAP4_SSL without supplying an ssl_context, relying on a default context that did not verify the server's X.509 certificate, enabling MITM disclosure of mail credentials/content. The fix explicitly builds ssl.create_default_context() (with an opt-out 'none' setting) and passes it to IMAP4_SSL, materially correcting the missing certificate validation. This matches the CVE-2023-39441 advisory description and the CWE-295/CRYPTO-010 hypothesis.
finding: IMAP4_SSL client created without a verifying SSL context; server certificate is not validated, enabling MITM interception of mail credentials and content.
note: Candidate package metadata lists apache-airflow-providers-smtp while the patched file is the IMAP provider hook (airflow/providers/imap/hooks/imap.py); the advisory covers both the SMTP and IMAP providers plus core Airflow, so this is a metadata granularity mismatch rather than a substantive conflict. No license information supplied.
